finding: Women aged 43 years or older who undergo assisted fertilization procedures have a higher risk of complications compared to women of the same age with spontaneous pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with ART-induced pregnancies had a higher rate of caesarean section (95% vs 70.3%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight in the ART group was 2641± 695 g compared to 3207±496 g in the spontaneous pregnancy group
